verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Brex lets admins set spend limits and per-transaction limits on cards, with procurement approval flows. Nothing documents a self-service screen where a user can request a transaction limit increase. Limit-setting controls, approval flows and Pipedream/API automation of monthly limits are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not the requested capability.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can request a transaction limit increase directly from a self-service screen
